axebozo: The new rifleman gave his name as Oskar Axebozo. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Oskar Axebozo signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a key to a house that is no longer there.
Oskar Axebozo reported for duty as a chaplain. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar Axebozo recovered it by touch and then had to wash again.

Oskar Axebozo was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. Verdel Ridge is lost. Oskar Axebozo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The list for Oskar Axebozo's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.
Oskar Axebozo held the gathering in a shelter after supper. The poem was read badly, the song went better, and nobody interrupted the silence.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F13. Oskar Axebozo was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F13. Oskar Axebozo was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.

The papers connected Nils Axebozo to Oskar Axebozo. The men took longer to learn Nils Axebozo's own habits, but they made the effort. As one of the first hundred volunteers, Nils Axebozo received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Nils Axebozo helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. Nils Axebozo left the work of a runner to become a chaplain. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Nils Axebozo found an old map of the Sunken Road from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. A letter from home found Nils Axebozo before the night shift. Nils Axebozo folded it small and kept it close.
Nils Axebozo ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.

Norbert Seamus of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at Calvary Farm. Nils Axebozo of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. A letter from home found Nils Axebozo before the night shift. Nils Axebozo folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet grazed Nils Axebozo's ribs at S-F13. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Edmund Owenhart of the Concord (@owenhart247). A letter from home found Nils Axebozo before the night shift. Nils Axebozo folded it small and kept it close.

Nils Axebozo is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Nils Axebozo watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Nils Axebozo and Roland Serreno split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. A letter from home found Nils Axebozo before the night shift. Nils Axebozo folded it small and kept it close. Nils Axebozo walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Nils Axebozo held a service beside a ration store. The men sang quietly so the sleepers behind the wall could rest. Nils Axebozo asked to leave the chaplains and serve as a signaller. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Nils Axebozo reads Walter Mat's letters from home out loud, because Walter never learned to read. Nils leaves out the sad parts. Walter knows. A letter from home found Nils Axebozo before the night shift. Nils Axebozo folded it small and kept it close.

Nils Axebozo and Matthias San sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. A letter from home found Nils Axebozo before the night shift. Nils Axebozo folded it small and kept it close.
Nils Axebozo sent a pigeon back to headquarters. The pigeon came back two hours later. Nils Axebozo took it personally.
Nils Axebozo pulled Roland Serreno out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
derpstera22: Viktor Derpstera, a carpenter from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F4. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Viktor Derpstera held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Viktor Derpstera folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Viktor Derpstera was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.

A bullet hit Viktor Derpstera in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at T-F4. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Silas "Tin" Roman of the Concord (@ba_roman98).
Viktor Derpstera lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
The stretcher Viktor Derpstera lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Viktor Derpstera is back at T-F4, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
Lucien "Tin" Wtm of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Viktor Derpstera kept the tin.
glauber.drak: They issued Dietrich Drak a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a tin of tobacco in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Dietrich Drak won before reaching the end of his entry. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at Q-F18 changed before the cheering ended. Dietrich Drak shouldered another load.
Dietrich Drak's hands still remember being a stonemason's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Dietrich Drak has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname, grazed.
Dietrich Drak crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F8 holds again.
Dietrich Drak saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at Q-F18 and fired once. Casimir "Owl" Lusaka was grazed.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Dietrich Drak waited for that to change. When it did, Gideon Nkmcnamee was grazed.
hackermt90: Otto Hackermt joined the replacements on Day 3. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached S-F5 with the rations. Otto Hackermt ate while listening to the revised orders.
Otto Hackermt brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

A shell landed square in S-F5. They found Otto Hackermt alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. A shell landed square in the trench at S-F5. Otto Hackermt was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.
Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt had heard about Otto Hackermt's courage. At S-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt and Ulrich Asher carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident. Hill 304 has been won. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt (Hegemony) and Ivo Boi (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Verdel Ridge. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone. A letter from home reached Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt before dusk. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt had Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas of the Concord in the sights at Hill 304 for a long second. Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas was lighting a pipe. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt let the match burn all the way down.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt accepted it as a review.
Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt was on the dawn watch at S-F5 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Otto Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home reached Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt before dusk. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F5 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt is number 184. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Henrik Guacamole, badly wounded. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
The cook borrowed Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
A muddy dog crawled into S-F5 through the wire. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit.
Biscuit has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt is very proud. Biscuit is mainly proud of the biscuits.
A replacement turned out to be from Tannenfeld too. Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
jonesmann829: Nobody asked Hugo Jonesmann why he came. Nobody in U-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Hugo Jonesmann fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F16. Norbert Levichapman was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Hugo Jonesmann shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Arno Here, was gravely wounded. Victory at Grey Mill. Hugo Jonesmann let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Hugo Jonesmann fired at a movement across the wire at U-F16. The man went down: Karel "Shadow" Pcampbellsmi, gravely wounded. A clear shot from U-F16. Hugo Jonesmann badly wounded Albin Lucwar and slid back down below the parapet. A letter from home found Hugo Jonesmann before the night shift. Hugo Jonesmann folded it small and kept it close.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Hugo Jonesmann waited for that to change. When it did, Matthias Jeremythomas was grazed. A letter from home found Hugo Jonesmann before the night shift. Hugo Jonesmann folded it small and kept it close.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Hugo Jonesmann's helmet at U-F16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.

The medic cut the last bandage off Hugo Jonesmann's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to U-F16 the same hour. A letter from home found Hugo Jonesmann before the night shift. Hugo Jonesmann folded it small and kept it close.

Hugo Jonesmann jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Oskar Landscapro. The Concord medics will be busy. (@landscapro) In the dark of the Concord trench Hugo Jonesmann hit Dorian Thecommander with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@thecommanderrod) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Hugo Jonesmann snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Hugo Jonesmann free. Hugo Jonesmann waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Hugo Jonesmann no longer needed it.
Dietrich Jonesmann joined U-F16 under the shadow of Hugo Jonesmann's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
lachie_fleming1: Day 10. The corporal put Teodor Fleming beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Across the wire at Lantern Hill, Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Teodor Fleming of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Teodor Fleming wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
The gun crews at U-F11 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Gustav Clarke was grazed.
Teodor Fleming did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Teodor Fleming fired back. Viktor Blacksmithsb was badly wounded.
Teodor Fleming mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Teodor Fleming said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Teodor Fleming only heard boots on the duckboards at U-F11, then nothing but pain. Raider: Oskar Reynolds of the Concord (@chase_reynolds_13).
lopz.oskr: Gustav Oskr came up on Day 13 carrying news from Rosenau. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Gustav Oskr's transfer to the role of runner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Dorian Hensley carried Gustav Oskr's rifle all the way up to the Drowned Farm after Gustav twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. A letter from home reached Gustav Oskr before dusk. Gustav Oskr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav Oskr drew the street leading to Rosenau. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. A letter from home reached Gustav Oskr before dusk. Gustav Oskr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gustav Oskr went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Yann Catto was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@kat_catto) Gustav Oskr came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. A letter from home found Gustav Oskr before the night shift. Gustav Oskr folded it small and kept it close.
michael.kuty: Norbert Kuty left a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was behind in Wyvern Cross and came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges. The men noticed at once that he knows every star by name.

Norbert Kuty heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. A letter from home reached Norbert Kuty before dusk. Norbert Kuty read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Norbert Kuty helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Norbert Kuty counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Valentin Abapo was grazed.
Norbert Kuty measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Norbert Kuty wrote a song about the Brickworks. Otto Boi wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Lightning lit Saint-Ash crossroads and Norbert Kuty saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at P-F13. Norbert Kuty was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Casimir Yelloowman of the Concord (@yelloowman).
Henrik Kuty came to the front because his father Norbert Kuty never came home. He carries a photograph gone soft at the edges.
oscizzus: Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Karel Sperring. The Concord medics will be busy. (@sean_sperring) Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R13. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Silas "Saint" Aatttttaaa of the Concord (@aatttttaaa). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus before dusk. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medic looked at Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-R13. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus before dusk. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read it twice and slept a little easier. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Benedikt Johnnyboi crossed it, Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus fired. Benedikt Johnnyboi was badly wounded. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus fired at a movement across the wire at R-R13. The man went down: Quentin "Shadow" Danny, gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus before dusk. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus before dusk. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-R13 is up. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus before dusk. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. A letter from home reached Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus before dusk. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus crawled the last yards. The letter for Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus was mostly about the weather at home. Ulrich "Tin" Oscizzus read that part twice too.
raymond216469: The new machine gunner gave his name as Wendel Raymond. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.

The water jacket hissed as Wendel Raymond fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Ulrich "Ash" Tiburoncito was badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Wendel Raymond looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Wendel Raymond had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Wendel Raymond answered to number 710. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Wendel Raymond read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Wendel Raymond took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-C13, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Bastian Ale of the Hegemony (@ale_3.7_2). Wendel Raymond was killed at S-C13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Bastian Ale of the Hegemony (@ale_3.7_2).
Yann Raymond came to the front because his cousin Wendel Raymond never came home. He carries a frozen apple.
Yann Raymond tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Yann Raymond closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Someone asked Yann Raymond to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Yann Raymond drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
richard_mccooper: On Day 4, Jakub Mccooper arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Cyril "Ash" Slade pulled Jakub Mccooper out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Jakub Mccooper pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Jakub Mccooper folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Jakub Mccooper caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F3 and grazed Jakub Mccooper's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military).
The wound on Jakub Mccooper's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
A bullet went through Jakub Mccooper's sleeve at S-F3 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ulrich Samuelbujore of the Concord (@samuelbujoreanu).

The medic looked at Jakub Mccooper's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Jakub Mccooper could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A bullet clipped Jakub Mccooper's helmet at S-F3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Tobias Aamir of the Concord (@aamir_pa2009). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Jakub Mccooper answered to number 250. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Jakub Mccooper shouldered another load.
Three days with a bandage, and Jakub Mccooper is back at S-F3. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Jakub Mccooper raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F3. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub Khattabka of the Concord (@khattabka_).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jakub Mccooper is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Jakub Mccooper felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F3. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Ulrich "Whistle" Belugawales of the Concord (@belugawales3).

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Jakub Mccooper in the open at S-F3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Jakub Mccooper fell at S-F3 and never moved again. Shot by Emil Military of the Concord (@the_john_military).
Walter "Shadow" Mccooper asked about Jakub Mccooper on arriving at S-F3. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
slothc5: In Halden, Benedikt Slothc was a tailor. In P-F9, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a tailor again.

Benedikt Slothc drew a map of Anselm Mazdarati's hometown from Anselm's stories. Anselm says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Benedikt Slothc before dusk. Benedikt Slothc read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt Slothc stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Benedikt Slothc got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Benedikt Slothc wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Benedikt Slothc traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Benedikt Slothc spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Benedikt Slothc dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
the_filipino_irishman: Florian Irishman came up on Day 10 carrying news from Wyvern Cross. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

A supply man offered Florian Irishman a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Irishman. Florian Irishman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Florian Irishman watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Florian Irishman was carrying water up to U-F3 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Florian Irishman did not. Shot by Benedikt Clintxix of the Hegemony (@clintxix). Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Irishman. Florian Irishman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The bearers moved Florian Irishman's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Florian Irishman returned to U-F3 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Florian Irishman raised his head for a heartbeat too long at U-F3. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel Damianbarres of the Hegemony (@damianbarresi).

Florian Irishman is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Florian Irishman read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
theramblingbot: Nobody asked Emil Theramblingb why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Emil Theramblingb tried writing with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will require imagination. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Emil Theramblingb stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord and Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.

Emil Theramblingb counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home found Emil Theramblingb before the night shift. Emil Theramblingb folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Emil Theramblingb tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F16 is up. A bullet clipped Emil Theramblingb's helmet at S-F16 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord (@henri.hakkinen.566). A letter from home found Emil Theramblingb before the night shift. Emil Theramblingb folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Emil Theramblingb did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Emil Theramblingb no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Emil Theramblingb before the night shift. Emil Theramblingb folded it small and kept it close.

Emil Theramblingb fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Jakub "Ash" Cocac, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Emil Theramblingb before the night shift. Emil Theramblingb folded it small and kept it close.
Emil Theramblingb tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Emil Theramblingb lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
Emil Theramblingb was on watch at S-F16 when the night raid hit. The men found Emil Theramblingb at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Pavel Tsanev of the Concord (@vl.tsanev).
The papers connected Lucien Theramblingb to Emil Theramblingb. The men took longer to learn Lucien Theramblingb's own habits, but they made the effort.

Listening post, three in the morning. Lucien Theramblingb heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Lucien Theramblingb is number 148. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Lucien Theramblingb could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Lucien Theramblingb. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Lucien Theramblingb brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

Lucien Theramblingb was hit in the forearm at S-F16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Norbert Bob of the Concord (@power_armor_bob).
Lucien Theramblingb came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Lucien Theramblingb was hit hard in the fight at S-F16 before anyone could fire. The raider was Karel Jonas of the Concord. Raider: Karel Jonas of the Concord (@hensley_jonas215).
wyatt_r_25: Felix Wyatt told the sergeant he was a schoolteacher. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
On a quiet night Felix Wyatt (Concord) and Wendel Jesus (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Felix Wyatt's ear at R-S15 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile of the Hegemony (@carnahanwiley). Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Felix Wyatt watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet hit Felix Wyatt in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-S15. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Severin Vazintian of the Hegemony (@vazintian). Felix Wyatt got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 551. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Felix Wyatt heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Someone moved Felix Wyatt's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Felix Wyatt recovered anyway and is back at R-S15.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Felix Wyatt accepted it as a review.
A recruit asked Felix Wyatt how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Nobody else in R-S15 wanted the stripes. Felix Wyatt said yes. Lance Corporal.
